react.why: The workspace must resolve a single React copy.

react-dom.why: The workspace must resolve a single React DOM copy.

react-native.why: The mobile app bundles a single React Native runtime.

electron.why: The desktop app ships a single Electron runtime.

lodash.why: Lodash versions were uniformized through the pnpm catalog (LIVE-35624).

@solana/web3.js.why: The Solana signer and coin module must share one web3.js.

replaced.why: Dependencies we replaced with a better alternative. Re-adding one needs a new decision.

react-native-device-info.use: expo-device, or expo-application for app version

expo-linear-gradient.reason: Adds a native module for what Lumen draws with react-native-svg (LIVE-37310).

unimported.reason: Mishandles dynamic import(), so every package needs an exception list to suppress its false positives. Pulls typescript@4.9.5 and @typescript-eslint@5 into node_modules.

secp256k1.why: The monorepo converges on @noble/curves for secp256k1 (LIVE-37372).

@noble/curves.reason: The implementation we converge on. Catalogued in pnpm-workspace.yaml.

@bitcoinerlab/secp256k1.reason: bitcoinjs `ecc` adapter. Depends on @noble/curves, no curve arithmetic of its own.

@dfinity/identity-secp256k1.reason: @dfinity signing identity. Depends on @noble/curves, no curve arithmetic of its own.

elliptic.reason: Legacy pure-JS curve library reached only through third-party SDKs, and the fallback secp256k1 uses when its bindings are missing. Pinned to 6.6.1 by a root pnpm override.
elliptic.exit: LIVE-37448 the SDKs stop pinning it, or we stop shipping them.

secp256k1.reason: Native bindings, reached only through icon-sdk-js.
secp256k1.exit: LIVE-37372 coin-icon drops icon-sdk-js, or the SDK stops depending on it.

@noble/secp256k1.reason: Standalone noble package superseded by @noble/curves. Pinned exactly by every SDK.
@noble/secp256k1.exit: LIVE-37448 the SDKs move to @noble/curves, or we stop shipping them.

expo-crypto.reason: The implementation we converge on. Backs the global crypto.getRandomValues through src/getRandomValuesPolyfill.ts.

react-native-get-random-values.reason: Imported by @hiero-ledger/cryptography, @ledgerhq/coin-evm@10.1.0 and @segment/analytics-react-native. Mobile aliases it to the expo-crypto shim in rspack.config.mjs and excludes it from autolinking.

react-native-randombytes.reason: Native module reached through node-libs-react-native's crypto shim (react-native-crypto).
react-native-randombytes.exit: node-libs-react-native is replaced, or its crypto shim no longer pulls it.
